title: Chain Lookup
tagline: Unleashing On-chain Clarity. ChainLookup assists users in on-chain analysis, helping them identify wash trading, rug pools, security flaws, &tokenomics insights through lookup scan and services
description:
Pain points of the Onchain analysis includes 1) Complex analysis 2) Lack of Notifications. 

Complex Analysis: Analyzing blockchain data for wash trading, rug pools, and security flaws is complex and time-consuming for the average user.

Lack of Notifications: Users lack a reliable system for real-time notifications about critical on-chain events related to specific Dapps.

How ChainLookup Addresses These Challenges:
Comprehensive Analysis: ChainLookup simplifies on-chain analysis, providing users with clear information on wash trading, rug pools, and security vulnerabilities.

User-Friendly Lookup: Users can easily raise request for ChainLookup assistance to DAO members or access quick contract analyses through ChainLookup Scan, and stay informed via Dapp alert subscriptions.

how_its_made:
It was challenging to set up automated real-time notifications for user-defined contract addresses.
Creating multiple subgraphs from user-defined addresses was difficult, but we plan to simplify this process by implementing Subgraph templates.
